editorial_reason: DLMF §18.2(i), equations 18.2.1–18.2.4_5: continuous, discrete and measure cases have distinct support, positivity and moment assumptions; do not silently identify the definitions or treat a finite support system as an infinite full degree sequence.

OpenStax Calculus 1 §4.10: the F+C uniqueness conclusion uses connected interval I; on disconnected domains constants on different components can differ. Indefinite integral notation represents a family, not a single numerical integral.
OpenStax Calculus 1 §2.5 assumes a full punctured interval. Relative-domain and one-sided versions need separate quantifier domains and accumulation-point/directional hypotheses; f(a) is irrelevant.
